message.content: {"basis": "The chart title and subtitle explicitly limit the displayed evidence to 'Selected Sentinel Sites' with the 'highest case loads.' This non-random, selected subset does not establish that the observed positive association between testing volume and positive cases is representative of the broader network. Therefore, the evidence is not ready to support a network-wide claim but warrants further review.", "option_label": "Route for broader population review before advancing a network-wide claim"}
